club.name: VibeCoding Club
club.pitch: Build real apps and games with AI coding tools. No experience needed.

hackathon.name: Blooket Hackathon
hackathon.description: A one-day build sprint. Teams use AI coding tools to make an original quiz game or classroom tool in the spirit of Blooket, then demo it live. $1,000 to the winners. Full details coming soon.
rules: Original art and names only. No Blooket logos, characters or screenshots.
Any AI tool is allowed. Say which ones you used.
Code written before kickoff does not count.
Every team demos, finished or not.
